<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  The simple stories (model stories@1): the heading, a description and the stories (posts) as a list, each with
  a cover picture, the title (a link when the story has an address) and a line. Axes: layout (grid: cards in
  columns, compact: small covers beside the copy on a card surface), cols (2, 3 columns).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { SimpleStory } from "./stories-simple.types";

export type StoriesSimpleProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description?: string;
  stories: SimpleStory[];
  level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
  padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
  align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
  layout?: "grid" | "compact";
  cols?: "2" | "3";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Link from "../compose/Link.vue";
import List from "../compose/List.vue";
import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import Text from "../compose/Text.vue";
import Title from "../compose/Title.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  description = "",
  stories,
  level = 2,
  padding = "standard",
  align = "center",
  layout = "grid",
  cols = "3",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<StoriesSimpleProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => id + "-title");
const column = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
  : "start"
);
const textAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
  : "text-start"
);
const itemsAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
  : "items-start"
);
const selfAlign = computed(() =>
  (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
  : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
  : ""
);
const grid = computed(() => ((cols as string) === "2") ? "md:grid-cols-2" : "md:grid-cols-3");
const item = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "compact" ? "flex flex-row items-center gap-4 rounded bg-card p-4 text-card-foreground border border-border"
  : "flex flex-col gap-4"
);
const coverRatio = computed(() =>
  (layout as string) === "compact" ? "1/1"
  : (cols as string) === "2" ? "16/9"
  : "4/3"
);
const cover = computed(() => ((layout as string) === "compact") ? "size-16 shrink-0" : "");
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="
      (padding as string) === 'compact' ? 'py-8 lg:py-16'
      : (padding as string) === 'spacious' ? 'py-24 lg:py-40'
      : 'py-16 lg:py-32'
    "
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
    data-slot="stories-simple"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
      <Stack gap="12" align="stretch">
        <Stack gap="4" :align="column" :class="cn('max-w-2xl', selfAlign)">
          <Title :as="level" size="3xl" weight="bold" :class="cn('tracking-tight', textAlign)" :id="titleId">
            {{ title }}
          </Title>
          <Text v-if="description" size="base" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', textAlign)">
            {{ description }}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
        <List tag="ul" :class="cn('m-0 w-full list-none p-0', cn('grid grid-cols-1 gap-8', grid))">
          <ListItem v-for="s in stories" :key="s.id" :class="item" data-slot="story">
            <MediaFrame :alt="s.title" :src="s.image" :ratio="coverRatio" :class="cover" />
            <Stack gap="2" align="start">
              <Link v-if="s.href" :href="urlOf(s.href)" variant="block">
                <Title :as="(level + 1)" size="lg" weight="semibold" class="text-start">
                  {{ s.title }}
                </Title>
              </Link>
              <Title v-else :as="(level + 1)" size="lg" weight="semibold" class="text-start">
                {{ s.title }}
              </Title>
              <Text v-if="s.description" size="sm" :class="cn('text-muted-foreground', 'text-start')">
                {{ s.description }}
              </Text>
            </Stack>
          </ListItem>
        </List>
      </Stack>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
